record.office: President Pro Tempore, North Dakota Senate
record.t: Was named President Pro Tempore of the North Dakota Senate, effective April 10, 2025.
record.q: Legislative Management Senator Kyle Davison District 41 | Republican R President Pro Tempore Effective 4/10/25
House Bills 1425 , 1417 and 1549 were introduced by Rep. Larry Klemin and co-sponsored by Rep. Karla Rose Hanson, Rep. Greg Stemen, Sen. Kyle Davison and Sen. Diane Larson.

record.t: Co-sponsored Senate Bill 2196, which passed the Senate 46-1 and the House 90-2.
record.q: Senate Bill 2196 was introduced by Sen. Donald Schaible and co-sponsored by Sens. Kyle Davison and Erin Oban and Reps. Pat Heinert, Cynthia Schreiber-Beck and Denton Zubke.
